name: comet-drawn mark into wordmark lockup with CTA
looks: A soft comet of light loops and tightens into the clean outline of a small leaf-like brand mark on a dark field. It cuts to the full wordmark beside the mark, with a short tagline underneath, a button, and a web address settling into place for the close.
build: The particle-flow-comet mechanic: a comet head follows a tightening parametric loop with a fading tail, converging into the mark's outline rather than a free figure-8. The lockup is DOM type with the tagline wiping in and a CTA button scaling in (the wordmark-assemble mechanic).
sound: A riser under the comet's loop, a soft chime as it resolves into the mark, a confident hit as the lockup and button land.
prompt: Let a soft trail of light loop and tighten until it draws the outline of a small brand mark, then cut to the full name beside it with a short tagline, a call-to-action button and a web address settling into a calm, confident close.
